name: FreeCol
notes: FreeCol's own server with every European and native nation played by FreeCol's AI, started the way FreeCol's main does and run in its only-AI-turns debug mode. FREECOL_DIR is the folder with FreeCol.jar, JAVA_BIN the JDK bin folder, FREECOL_EUROPEANS the European nations (classic rules allow up to 8) and FREECOL_MAP the map as WIDTHxHEIGHT tiles.
